pinned_identity.second_exact_deployment: same product and all six pinned preloads

hardware_observation.first_manual_presmoke_step: failed before a banner or usable REPL
hardware_observation.first_red_rule: stopped; no downstream hardware case was claimed

preserved_failure_state.interpretation: The C2 image decode and export publication completed; the sole following failure return is the KERNAL-window ownership CRC check.

breakpoint_diagnosis.method: fresh exact deployment with a hardware breakpoint after c2k_copy and before c2k_crc16; raw serial-monitor physical reads

root_cause.mechanism: On the 45GS02, llvm-mos emits STZ for C zero stores and relies on its Z==0 ABI invariant. Firmware-owned execution returned with Z==0x06. c2_kernal_take_ownership began with SEI but did not normalize Z before generated zero stores, so IRQ controls and every zero field in the Enhanced-DMA descriptor received 0x06.
root_cause.why_the_crc_failed: The corrupted descriptor did not copy the pinned Attic window to physical bank-0 $e000; the mapped-window CRC correctly rejected publication.
root_cause.why_the_screen_was_black: The failure occurs after interrupts are masked and before product ownership is published; main records error 37 and returns without a usable display path.

required_fix_and_gate.product_fix: Normalize Z to zero immediately after SEI at the firmware-to-C ownership boundary, before any compiler-generated store.
required_fix_and_gate.fixed_block_payment: Replace the two explicit LDA #0 / STA DMA trigger-register writes with two STZ writes under the newly bound Z==0 invariant; expected handoff-section delta is zero bytes.
required_fix_and_gate.permanent_gate: Disassembly requires SEI; LDZ #0 as the first ownership instructions and rejects missing, late or nonzero normalization; it also binds both size-payment STZ instructions.
required_fix_and_gate.hardware_recheck: Fresh candidate must execute the same pre-smoke, then the complete C2.2 hardware and acceptance chain; no Link-19 green is inherited.

claim_limit: Receipt-less hardware diagnosis of Link 19 only. It proves a first-red at the firmware-to-C Z-register ABI boundary and no hardware acceptance, product promotion or release claim.
